card.name: Words before a past-time reference
card.fires_on: Event or action words in news text (paper, held, call, wrote, hearing, man) where a past-time phrase like "last year", "last month" or "last night's" may come next.

modes.label: Event noun before a time
modes.description: A noun for an event or publication, after which a past date such as last month or in September may follow.

modes.label: Past-tense verb
modes.description: A past-tense verb about something that happened, followed by a time phrase.

modes.label: Time word leading into "last"
modes.description: Words like from, since or late that lead into a past-time phrase.
modes.example: pixel map<< from>> last night’s map

card.writes: It raises the word "last" as the next word, as in last year or last week.
card.plain: It fires on news words after which a phrase like "last year" or "last month" is likely to come.
